headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 4, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Chicago Cubs, securing a 17-1 victory. Masyn Winn led the Cardinals' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs. The Washington Nationals secured a 9-5 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Foster Griffin earning the win. Daylen Lile led the Pirates' offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, impacting their teams' lineups. Jakob Junis, a right-handed pitcher for the Texas Rangers, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to left hip impingement, effective retroactive to July 1, 2026. Evan Sisk, a left-handed pitcher for the Pittsburgh Pirates, has also been placed on the 15-day injured list due to left elbow inflammation. Other players, including Freddy Fermin, Randy Vásquez, Julio Rodríguez, Cooper Criswell, Ryan Helsley, and Bennett Sousa, have been placed on the injured list due to various injuries.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place. The Cleveland Guardians acquired Ryan Degges from the Philadelphia Phillies for cash. The Washington Nationals acquired Tom Cosgrove from the Houston Astros for cash and traded Kyle Nicolas to the Nationals for Randal Diaz. The Athletics traded Brett Harris to the Boston Red Sox for Ben Hansen.

top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 5-9 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Foster Griffin earning the win. Daylen Lile led the Pirates' offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Twins 5-2**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-2 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Gerrit Cole earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Trent Grisham led the Twins' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Shut Out Reds in Dominant Performance**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 3-0 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Trevor Rogers earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Samuel Basallo led the Orioles' offense with a home run and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Nationals 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Washington Nationals, securing a 7-1 victory. Bryan Reynolds and Braxton Ashcraft led the way for the Pirates, while Ryan O'Hearn and James Wood had notable performances for the Nationals.

top_news.title: **Rangers' Junis Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Jakob Junis, a right-handed pitcher for the Texas Rangers, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to left hip impingement, effective retroactive to July 1, 2026.

top_news.title: **Trade Alert: Ryan Degges Heads to Cleveland**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians have acquired RHP Ryan Degges in a trade with the Philadelphia Phillies for cash.
